logline: The Fresh Start Effect: You tell yourself you will start when you feel ready—the calendar is what moved 43,012 people to start. Backed by Hengchen Dai, Katherine L. Milkman & Jason Riis (3 Studies, 66,062 Goals).
director_vision: An intimate psychological thriller aesthetic in Humanized Editorial Explainer (Vox & Johnny Harris Style). Grounding abstract decision theory in tangible physical textures, dramatic directional chiaroscuro, and purposeful camera choreography that mirrors the cognitive trap of The Fresh Start Effect.
soundtrack_theme: Analog suspense score anchored at 45Hz sub-bass, Mid/Side vocal pocket ducking, and tactile physical Foley reflecting The Fresh Start Effect.
